IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Friday, September 25, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is running hot on data center work. Gurtz and Cupertino are both reposting 30-hand calls each at the Port Washington Data Center, paying **JW wage plus $10/hr** with a valid WI license required. That's clean money on a repost, which means the work is solid and they're cycling bodies through. Sixty-one calls across 275 hands keeps the book tight—if you're looking to land quick, this is a move.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** is the standout for raw pay. Rosendin is running three separate calls out of Claude with **$52.3/hr**, plus **$40/day zone pay** and a 60/60/50 OT structure—that's double time after 60 in a week. Seventy-six hands needed on Inside JW work; if you've got your NFPA 70E current, this board is calling. Michels Power also posted a Lineman call at **$60.59/hr** in Midland with **$175/day per diem** and 6-12 schedules, but that's transmission, not inside.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** has 104 calls chasing 785 hands—a rare seller's market. Miller Electrical is stacked with 79-hand calls at QTS Fayetteville, **$42/hr** on data center buildout (conduit, cable tray). Inglett & Stubbs sits right there too at the same rate, running 4-10s and 2-8s under General Foreman Tommy Jett. Book depth is clear; if you're mobile, Atlanta is moving.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** is smaller but clean. O'Connell and Ferguson Electric are both locked on Lake Mariner Data Center at **$48.2/hr**, first shift 6:30 AM–5:00 PM, with per diem incentives available. Ferguson is throttling intake to 15 bodies per day, so orientation discipline matters.

**LU-575 Portsmouth, OH** has an anomaly: two massive Amazon North Campus calls (94 hands each from TSC alone) starting Monday, September 28, on 4-10s—but zero wage data posted. That's unusual for a board this size and this urgent. Call the hall before you roll; something's off in the posting.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is the dark horse. B & D Industries has two reposted calls out of Project Miner in Santa Teresa, New Mexico, at **$70/hr** with double time after 40 hours. That rate and the OT structure make this worth the interstate move if you're chasing top dollar.

Data center work is the engine right now—40% of these boards are riding QTS, Meta, or Amazon builds. Hands are following the silicon.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Friday, September 25, 2026**

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** is the board to watch—28 calls, ~122 hands needed, and the work stacks deep. SERVICE ELECTRIC's Social Circle Energize job is running **$56.80/hr** (with Quanta barehand cert pulling **$10/hr over scale**), while HEART UTILITIES is moving 20 JLs into Savannah at **$46.80/hr**, 5-10s, **$150/day** per diem. FAITH ELECTRIC is posting **$49.80/hr** with hotels comped in College Park/Columbus. This is one of the few boards where nearly every call lists a rate—demand is real.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** sits tight with 7 calls but serious transmission work. MICHELS POWER's Midland job hits **$60.59/hr** (Journeyman Lineman, 6-12s, **$175/day** per diem)—one of the hottest transmission plays on the board. ROSENDIN is **$52.30/hr** inside work in Claude with 60/60/50 OT structure and 40/day zone pay. HEARTLAND and DACON round out the picture at **$50** and **$53.72/hr** respectively.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** is firing hard: 16 calls, ~31 hands, and Ampjack America's tower-raise work in Valpo/New Carlisle hits **$67.18/hr** Journeyman Lineman with **$200/day** per diem. MJ Electric and Kent Power both post **$56.66/hr** on 345kv lattice and substation reroute work. P&G Power's Goshen call runs **$67.18/hr** on 69kv distribution pole sets.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** has 6 calls but 96 hands chasing data center work. Copperhead and Cache Valley are both **$48.25/hr** inside JW with night shift and day schedules running 4-10s and 5-10s respectively—night shift gets **$10 over scale**. ArchKey is **$38.25/hr** at the Google Data Center in West Memphis, AR.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** moves 24 calls on a 30-hand board—tight work. Most calls run specialty trades (tree trim, telecom, fire alarm), and pay ranges **$24.18–$64.74/hr** depending on cert level and location.

**LU-175 Chattanooga, TN** has 18 calls but lists no rates—nuclear and TVA plant work dominate, with Day and Zimmermann and Energy Solutions running Task Managed rates on Watts Bar and Sequoyah MODS calls requiring TVA clearance.

Data-center buildout (Memphis, Amarillo, Grand Forks) and transmission infrastructure (Indiana, Texas) are pulling hands hard; nuclear work sits on the bench waiting for clearances.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, September 24, 2026**

**LU-213 St. John, NB** is running heavy with 8 calls and 31 hands on the board. Irving Oil Refinery is the anchor—CAM's got 9 journeyman pipefitters on day shift under GPMA Agreement, plus 7 F3/F4 welder slots (testing required), and two separate apprentice instrument tech calls (6 and 4 hands) rotating days and nights. This is refinery work with real staying power. The entire board is Irving-locked, which means consistency but zero optionality if that contract shifts.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 8 calls, 29 hands. US Eng. Metalworks is hunting 3 fitters with stainless experience and 4 SS TIG welders out of their shop. Apollo's pushing 7 fitters into DC2 Data Center in Aurora on 6/10s days at commercial rate plus incentive (specifics TBD at dispatch). US Eng. Construction needs high-purity fitters with tube bending chops for Broadcom in Fort Collins—that's semiconductor-adjacent work, finicky specs. Trautman and Shreve's got 3 combo welder slots (MIG/TIG), 1 day and 2 swing. Specialty skill stacks rule this board.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** has 5 calls, 45 hands. Gem's fab shop is testing combo welders (bennies don't stack). Graham's got 8 pipefitters into Cenovus Maintenance running 6-10s with spotty OT starting 6am. BDO Fab Shop is moving 8 more pipefitters into 7-10s (apprenticeship pathway available). Upland Mechanical's Lima Data Center play is sweet—8 pipefitters, all OT paid at double time, scheduled 5-1. That's the standout: OT at full premium is rare.

**LU-325 Fredericton, NB** shows 1 call, 1 hand. Pivot's placing a journeyman pipefitter at Job #6033 (Pepsi Moncton Site) on 5-10s with possible overtime. Thin board but clean work.

Data center builds and refinery maintenance are pulling hands faster than fab shops can feed them.
